[quote=lavinsworth_united_islands;60484400][spoiler=[b]Expectations of Diplomacy[/b]]
On the island of Malce, two men sit on the balcony of a chateau overlooking an ancient vineyard. They ponder recent events between sips of Lavinsworth family wine, a brand which has existed longer than the country they serve. Ah, the weather here is a fine complement to this red. Hopefully recent events will bring me here more often. Looking at his friend, the Intelligence Specialist would smile. Oh how I pity you in that nice ocean view office. Wouldnt want anything but the best? 

Rolling his eyes, the Defence Minister would pour himself another glass before replying. It's simply the change of atmosphere. Everything here seems so heavy with history. Doesnt even feel like were still in Lavia. Pausing for a second, he would ponder such fact, and the history the island would soon see as well. How much longer till the president as well as the diplomat gets here? Witstrom would ask, the topic suddenly coming to the forefront of his mind.

His companion responded bluntly, barely taking his eyes off the commuter ferry on the horizon. The President gets here tomorrow at roughly 0900, and the diplomat follows at roughly at 1300. After another sip of wine, Witstrom would continue his questioning. Think the newly radical diplomat will enjoy us meeting him at such a place like this? He gestured, using his already empty glass to point at the old luxury of the house. 

The other man would smirk a little. Oh please. He was a past diplomat to the Vespurians. Nothing here could top the obnoxious narcissistic opulence which their higher class busies itself with. Stopping to take a sip of wine, he would continue. I dont believe he is a member of that new insane party there either. Might be the only reasonable person in their whole government now. Witstrom would smile and nod. Right you are Carlos, right you are [/spoiler]

For context, Malce is my Elyseran/Vespurian (can't remember which it belongs to) territory, right under Lamandica. Sorry that it's so short, but I don't have much thought on what to add lol.[/quote]

Landing in his Wolo-57. A small private aircraft that the royalists previously enjoyed for diplomatic missions, but now had been seized for the republicans for in General Government travel. Klos Reuter would be looking through his "script," per se. Really, it was just a list of items that both Muller and Fuelenger had asked, or demanded that he speak to the Livonians about. These were, in order of importance to him at least: Stabilization of Relations Military Access, Informing them of the plans to seize the islands, naval equipment acquisitions, including a Destroyer and an Amphibious assault ship. And finally, an arms deal for buying and or licensing more ground equipment. Nervously, he would step out of the aircarft onto the tarmac below, escorted by members of the Internal Revolutionary Guard, and taken to car that had been delivered for his usage before hand, the driver would take him to the meeting location. Looking upon the place it would be a reminder of not only the luxury of Vespurias, but the luxury that he had seen across pre-war floueschia. 

"The view is beautiful here." He says to himself aloud, reminiscing when he was just a simple diplomat, who could use his free travel and acess to an aircraft to travel across Erene. 

He waits outside of the building to meet with the Lavian President and the other government personnel whom he was there to meet with. In the meantime, he would take some more time to run through his notes and conversation topics one more time, to hopefully make sure he doesn't slip up during the meeting.

Two years ago, 8 frontiersmen were hunting in the mountains. They belonged to no nation, and they were part of a small hunter-gatherer tribe that had no contact with the outside world. They were looking for llamas to eat in a valley when they stumbled across what looked like a disorganized mess of white line that seemed to stretch on for miles. Curious, they decided to climb up the nearest mountain. When they reached the top of the mountain, they could not believe their eyes. There was an intricate pattern of an arrow leading south, surrounded by condors, Jjaguars, llamas and alpacas surrounding the arrow. Just then, a flock of condors seemed to dive from the clouds and head in the direction of the arrow. The group suddenly felt an urge to go in the direction of the arrow for they believed there was prosperity and a surplus of resources to the south. When they walked back to their tribe's temporary shelter, they told the elders what had happened. The elders said it was a sign from the gods and that they must go south to the coast.
The walk to the coast was grueling and dangerous. A third of the tribesmen had died. Hunger ravaged the tribe, for they were low on food and could find none. In order to help his tribe reach the promise land, a man named Lonunzo rose to the chief of his tribe. He made the healthy hunt for food and the hungry stay in bed to not waste energy. He heard voices in his head telling him where food was. And the voices in his head were somehow right. The tribe somehow now had a surplus of food, thanks to Lonunzo. When they reached the southern coast, their breath was taken away. Before them was a meadow filled with trees and animals. There was also evidence of ruined buildings. Lonunzo's voice in his head told him to go inside the largest ruin. There was nothing inside but a stone tablet with mysterious language and some roots. Lonunzo's voice told him to plant the seeds in the ground and water them daily. After many days, the roots grew into plants and grew potatoes. Lonunzo tried a potato and liked it.  He saved some for planting. He gave away his potatoes to his tribe and they realized the value of the potatoes. No longer did the tribe need to wander around anymore. A small civilization began to grow. Then Lonunzo asked one more question to the voice in his head. 
"What shall I call my nation?"
The voice replied, "Do you see the prosperity of this land, and do you see the condors flying above you? Have I helped you be guided to this land? Build me a church, to never forget what I did."

"But you never answered my question."
"You already know the answer."
Lonunzo did know the answer. He was to call his nation "Wavakia" after the condors ("wava" in his language) and "akia", the name of his nation.

The OERs coordinated land, air, and naval counterstrikes supported by Operation Night Blanketed shattered Kiryuseis offensive power, forcing a full retreat north of the 11th Meridian.

By May 1, southern Kiryusei lay devastated under continuous bombardment. OER regained all occupied territories, encircled Kiryuseis forces, and imposed a full aerial and maritime blockade. Major Kiryusei logistical hubs and supply lines were destroyed, leading to severe shortages, mass desertions, and a total collapse of command structure.
